about_the_game:
TWO NIGHTMARES, ONE MANSION

Escape from Crimson Manor: Trapped Together is not just a horror game; it delivers two complete experiences designed to test your nerves and your deductive skills. Set in a sprawling, interconnected Victorian mansion filled with secrets, hidden passages, and dark machinery, the fate of your blood hangs in the balance.

🗝️ CO-OP MODE (2 Players): The Alliance

Prefer logic over panic? Join forces with a friend in a Narrative Campaign dedicated entirely to complex puzzles.

  • Separated but Connected: Wake up in opposite wings of the mansion. Voice communication is your only weapon.

  • Exchange Mechanics: One player has the recipe, the other has the ingredients. Use the dumbwaiter system to trade tools, keys, and crucial clues between floors.

🩸 ASYMMETRIC MODE (3v1): The Blood Harvest

Up to three survivors. One Alchemist obsessed with immortality. In this high-stakes mode, the villain's goal isn't just to kill—it is to harvest.

  • The Alchemist: Master the mansion’s network of Dumbwaiters and hidden chutes to ambush your victims. Drag them to the secret laboratory, strap them into the Transfusion Machine, and drain their vital essence. With every liter of blood extracted, you become younger, faster, and more lethal.

  • The Survivors: Choose from unique classes (The Gardener, The Governess, The Architect). Use stealth, sabotage the Alchemist’s traps, and locate the blood vials hidden across the 25 rooms to break the lockdown before you are bled dry.

KEY FEATURES

  • The Anemia System: Health is not just a bar; it’s a resource. Losing blood blurs your vision and slows your movement. Manage your vitality, or you’ll end up crawling through the corridors.

  • Dynamic Mansion: 2 Floors, 2 Wings, and a Central Hub interconnected by a web of tunnels and service elevators. Learning the map is the difference between life and death.

  • Gothic Horror: An oppressive Victorian atmosphere, inheriting the legacy of the hit The Inheritance of Crimson Manor, now expanded with enhanced visuals and new dark zones.

  • Infinite Replayability: Item locations, puzzles, and escape routes shift in every match of the Asymmetric mode. No two hunts are ever the same.

Will you become the final ingredient for the serum, or will you escape the Crimson Manor?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 Sp1
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460, 2.70GHz or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound

short_description: Enter the Crimson Manor in this dual multiplayer horror experience. Choose your nightmare: trust your partner’s life in a story-driven 2-Player Co-op puzzle campaign. or Hunt and extract blood as "The Alchemist" in a dynamic 3v1 Asymmetric mode.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
